researched.status: all section research files are research-ready with caveats

partialOrPolicySections.handoffNote: Preserve the four-part MultiLineString/gap handling; geometry-index records max official break 1908.67 m.
Official gaps are about 203 m and 111 m; preserve as MultiLineString until an explicit connector policy exists.
Preserve the 112.88 m official segment break and the official Frillesas-to-Steninge coastal network gap; do not stitch to K5.
Keep the 762.82 m sparse-segment QA caveat before navigation-grade use.

sourceArtifactsToUse: trail.research.json for official inventory and section order
sections/*.research.json for section caveats, endpoint notes, facilities, rules and do-not-import guidance

normalized-candidate/protected-area-overlays.research.json for research-only route-bbox protected-area, Natura 2000, water-protection, regulatory-area and biotopskydd overlaps against canonical geometry
sourceArtifactsToSuppress: Official API line.geometry fields when section research says they are empty, stale or misleading
Older Naturkartan, OSM, route-app or paper-map-derived linework when section files mark it stale, validation-only or non-canonical
transformPolicy: Use canonical GeoJSON as exact official GPX track/segment coordinates converted to GeoJSON.
Use draw-ready GeoJSON only for display QA; it linearly densifies long intra-segment official jumps over 250 m toward a 75 m target step and does not change official segment breaks.
Do not treat draw-ready interpolation points as field-verified trail turns.
Do not bridge official MultiLineString or track/segment breaks unless a later verified connector source is found.
Do not add invented connector geometry across the K4-to-K5 coastal network gap.
endpointContinuityIssues: N5 has four-part MultiLineString/gap handling and the practical endpoint is at Gallarpasjon/Gallarp rather than Nosslinge church.
N8 official GPX endpoint sits about 60-65 m from the shared Akulla junction.
S1/S2 handoff gap at Oskarstrom is 2.94 m.
K1/K2 handoff gap at Kungsbacka C is about 17 m.
K3 has official gaps of about 203 m near Nasungevagen/Mor Annas vag and 111 m near Badviksvagen/Asa beach.
K4-to-K5 is a large official coastal gap and K5/K6 Haverdal handoff is about 13 m.
K6/K7 handoff is about 1 m, K7/K8 is about 5.34 m, K8/K9 is about 3.23 m, and K9/K10 is about 10.82 m.
Branch nodes at Akulla, Astad/Byasjon, Kvarnforsen, Frodeparken, Gyltige, Simlangsdalen, Halmstad C and Koarp need explicit graph/topology decisions rather than a single linear chain.
blockedGeometry: None missing locally; hard geometry blockers are policy decisions around official breaks, endpoint snapping and the K4-to-K5 official coastal network gap.

dedupeClusterPolicy: Cluster shared endpoint facilities before section import, especially Kungsbacka C, Tjoloholm, Akulla/Yasjon, Byasjon/Astad, Gyltige, Simlangsdalen, Halmstad C, Haverdal, Mastocka, Ekegarden and Koarp.
Cluster same-site shelter, fireplace, toilet, water, waste, information board and parking records before creating user-facing markers.
Keep commercial/private services and public transport stops as access or nearby-service metadata unless the section file marks them core on-route facilities.
Use section routeProximity and importDecision/import notes where present; do not bulk-import all official places API records.
suppressOrPendingClasses: Suppress stale-stage, adjacent-stage and old-segmentation facility leakage called out in section files.
Keep OSM-only water/fire/picnic candidates pending until verified by official, manager, field or current source evidence.
Do not model natural waters, springs, lakes or shelters as potable water unless the section file has a verified drinking-water source.
Do not model public transport shelters as hiking shelters.
Do not import side-service records beyond the eventual side-service radius/policy.
highRiskFacilityCategories: Drinking water that is seasonal, conditional, private, staffed-only, dry-risk or absent from official water POIs.
Shelter, campsite and tenting records inside or near reserves with no-fire/no-camping/designated-place rules.
Fireplaces, grills and firewood records because dynamic fire bans and reserve rules can override prepared sites.
Toilets and showers with seasonal, staffed, vandalism-closure or opening-hours caveats.
Dense urban/beach/resort services around Kungsbacka, Varberg, Ullared, Halmstad, Tylosand, Mellbystrand and Bastad station.

protectedAreas: Research-only GIS overlay is computed against canonical geometry: 87 protected/restriction records retained, with 68 route-overlapping areas, 18 facility-overlapping areas, 91 route-overlap records and 98 facility-overlap records across protected-area, Natura 2000, water-protection, regulatory-area and biotopskydd source layers.

Use route-subsegment warnings only where protected-area overlays intersect canonical candidate route geometry; keep nearby/context-only areas out of route spans unless future authoritative geometry changes the result.
Use facility/site-level warnings where overlay polygons contain candidate facility points, especially shelter, fire, tenting, water, toilet, beach and endpoint clusters.

Kungsbackafjorden regulatory-area overlap carries seasonal bird/access restrictions from 1/3 to 30/6; Trönninge ängar has a facility-site regulatory overlap with year-round access restriction metadata. Preserve these date conditions in descriptions.
waterProtection: Assign water-protection warnings to the route subsegments and facility/site points confirmed by normalized-candidate/protected-area-overlays.research.json.
Do not mark natural water potable; carry contamination/washing/waste/toileting cautions where section research calls for them.
fire: Use established fireplaces only where imported and legal.
Reserve-specific fire rules override general right-of-public-access guidance.
Run live MSB/municipality/rescue-service fire-risk and fire-ban checks immediately before publication/import.
dogs: Carry the official 1 March-20 August strict-supervision/leash-period guidance.
Add beach, reserve, livestock/pasture and local dog-rule caveats from each section file.
camping: Do not generalize allemansratten into a formal campsite.
Encode no-camping/designated-place/two-night/seasonal rules exactly where section files and final GIS overlay support them.
liveChecksBeforePublication: Official Hallandsleden current information and reroute pages
Closures, bridge/path works, forestry/hunting notices and beach rules

importOrder.notes: Validate schema, coordinate order, distance tolerances and endpoint graph without writing runtime app data.

importOrder.sections: All sections except N5, K3 and K4
importOrder.notes: Carry long-internal-segment draw-ready caveats; defer publication until facility/rule policies are resolved.
Import only after deciding how official MultiLineString breaks are represented.
Treat K4-to-K5 as an explicit official network gap; do not imply continuous coastal coverage through Falkenberg/Varberg.
Run dedupe, GIS overlays and live checks before user-facing publication.

publicationTimeRechecks: Transit, closures/reroutes, fire status, beach/reserve rules and seasonal services immediately before publication/import.
Water, toilet, cafe/shop, shelter/campsite and private/commercial service availability.
Confirm the computed protected-area overlay remains current if source layers or candidate geometry change before publication.

openDecisionsForUser: Choose endpoint snapping threshold and whether snapped graph nodes preserve original official endpoints in provenance metadata.
Choose representation for official MultiLineString breaks: preserve as route gaps, model as warning spans, or require external connector evidence.
Choose how to show the K4-to-K5 official coastal network gap in runtime UX.
Choose side-service radius and categories for dense urban/beach/resort areas.
Choose whether facilities marked conditional/private/seasonal/pending are imported as hidden review records, user-facing caveated markers, or deferred.
validationChecklist: Parse trail.research.json, research-progress.json, all sections/*.research.json, geometry/geometry-index.research.json and both new normalization handoff JSON files.
Confirm expected section count is 35 and every section has canonical and draw-ready geometry.
Validate every canonical/draw-ready GeoJSON Feature geometry type and coordinate order.
Confirm draw-ready geometry is not used as canonical provenance.

Confirm K4-to-K5 is represented as a known official network gap.
Run endpoint gap report and review all snaps above the chosen threshold.
Compare official distances, computed distances and section source contradictions before exposing distances.
